help: Remove `once`. It does not stop later reruns; stop the handle or use `watch(..., { once: true })`.

message: `watchEffect` created inside a repeating watcher callback is not stopped when that callback ends
help: Keep the inner stop handle, register it with `onCleanup` / `onWatcherCleanup`, or re-enter an owner `scope.run` (outer 5:1, source 6:28). The first immediate run may be scope-owned; later callbacks still leak.
